```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-957-WHT-01956'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT SUM(CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant) AS total_part_qty
FROM model_bom mb
JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.component_id
WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL4-120WAL24-0509')
  AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01');
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL4-120BLK95-0386')
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        bt.qty_per_model * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT SUM(bt.qty_per_model) AS total_qty
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bt.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-943-BLK-00530';
```

```sql
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * mt.qty_per_model
    FROM model_tree mt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mt.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mt.qty_per_model), 0) AS total_qty
FROM model_tree mt
JOIN component c ON mt.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
WITH model_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs mapping to the model
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE5-140WAL72-0654'
),
bundle_model_skus AS (
    -- SKUs inside bundles that map to the model
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku bundle ON bi.bundle_sku_id = bundle.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE5-140WAL72-0654'
      AND bundle.is_bundle = true
),
all_model_skus AS (
    SELECT * FROM model_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM bundle_model_skus
)
SELECT SUM(ol.qty * ams.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN all_model_skus ams ON l.sku_id = ams.sku_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, expand bundle to item SKUs and their models
bundle_models AS (
    -- BDL-UK-0265 bundle items -> item SKUs -> models
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty_per_bundle
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-UK-0265')
),
-- Then recursively expand all component BOMs from those models
model_parts AS (
    -- Direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        bm.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        bm.model_qty_per_bundle * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bundle_models bm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON bm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        mp.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mp.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN component c ON mp.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(mp.total_qty), 0) AS units
FROM model_parts mp
JOIN component c ON mp.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-960-WAL-02843'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model_expanded AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs map directly to models
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku s ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bi.item_sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
),
model_parts AS (
    -- Direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        sme.sku_id,
        sme.model_id,
        sme.qty AS model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty
    FROM sku_model_expanded sme
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sme.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive expansion of assembly components
    SELECT 
        mp.sku_id,
        mp.model_id,
        mp.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mp.component_qty * cb.qty AS component_qty
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mp.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(mp.model_qty * mp.component_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM model_parts mp
JOIN component c ON mp.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE mp.sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-CA-0316')
  AND c.component_code = 'FOO-680-BLK-01235'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up through component BOMs to find all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'BRA-882-WAL-01433'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all model-component relationships for the target part (including through sub-assemblies)
model_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        SUM(CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY mb.model_id
),
-- Get item SKUs in the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS item_qty_in_bundle
    FROM sales_sku bundle
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE bundle.sku_code = 'BDL-JP-0279'
      AND bundle.is_bundle = true
),
-- Map item SKUs to models and compute part quantity per item SKU
item_model_part AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.item_qty_in_bundle,
        sm.model_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku,
        mpq.part_qty_per_model
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_part_qty mpq ON sm.model_id = mpq.model_id
)
-- Sum up total part quantity in one bundle
SELECT SUM(item_qty_in_bundle * model_qty_per_sku * part_qty_per_model) AS total_part_qty
FROM item_model_part;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up through component BOMs to find all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-874-OAK-02567'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all model-component relationships for the target part (including through sub-assemblies)
model_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        SUM(CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY mb.model_id
),
-- Get all SKUs that map to models containing the part
sku_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        SUM(CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) * mpq.part_qty_per_model) AS part_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN model_part_qty mpq ON sm.model_id = mpq.model_id
    GROUP BY sm.sku_id
),
-- Expand bundles to their item SKUs
bundle_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS item_qty_in_bundle
    FROM bundle_item bi
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle = true)
),
-- Get part quantity per SKU, including bundles
sku_total_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle,
        COALESCE(spq.part_qty_per_sku, 0.0) AS direct_part_qty,
        COALESCE(SUM(be.item_qty_in_bundle * spq2.part_qty_per_sku), 0.0) AS bundle_part_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    LEFT JOIN sku_part_qty spq ON s.sku_id = spq.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN bundle_expanded be ON s.sku_id = be.bundle_sku_id
    LEFT JOIN sku_part_qty spq2 ON be.item_sku_id = spq2.sku_id
    GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.is_bundle, spq.part_qty_per_sku
),
-- Get completed order lines for the store in 2023
order_lines_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
)
-- Sum total part quantity consumed
SELECT SUM(ol.qty * COALESCE(stpq.direct_part_qty + stpq.bundle_part_qty, 0.0)) AS total_part_qty
FROM order_lines_2023 ol
JOIN sku_total_part_qty stpq ON ol.sku_id = stpq.sku_id;
```

```sql
    FROM bundle_sku_items bsi
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bsi.item_sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id

        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm

    FROM bundle_sku_items bsi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bsi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id

-- Get completed orders in US stores for 2025
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT
        s.sku_code AS sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
       AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
       AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT
        b.sku_code AS sku_code,
        uc2.child_code AS model_code,
        be.qty * uc2.qty AS qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition be
        ON be.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND be.parent_code = b.sku_code
       AND be.child_kind = 'sku'
       AND be.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
       AND (be.valid_to IS NULL OR be.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku item
        ON item.sku_code = be.child_code
       AND item.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition uc2
        ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND uc2.parent_code = item.sku_code
       AND uc2.child_kind = 'model'
       AND uc2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
       AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR uc2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
model_parts AS (
    WITH RECURSIVE comp_tree(model_code, component_code, qty) AS (
        -- Model -> direct components
        SELECT
            uc.parent_code AS model_code,
            uc.child_code AS component_code,
            uc.qty AS qty
        FROM u_composition uc
        WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'model'
          AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
          AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

        UNION ALL

        -- Assembly component -> child components
        SELECT
            ct.model_code,
            uc.child_code AS component_code,
            ct.qty * uc.qty AS qty
        FROM comp_tree ct
        JOIN component c
            ON c.component_code = ct.component_code
           AND c.is_assembly = true
        JOIN u_composition uc
            ON uc.parent_kind = 'component'
           AND uc.parent_code = ct.component_code
           AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
           AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
           AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    )
    SELECT
        ct.model_code,
        ct.component_code,
        SUM(ct.qty) AS qty
    FROM comp_tree ct
    JOIN component c
        ON c.component_code = ct.component_code
       AND c.is_assembly = false
    GROUP BY ct.model_code, ct.component_code
)
SELECT
    SUM(sm.qty * mp.qty) AS total_qty
FROM sku_models sm
JOIN model_parts mp
    ON mp.model_code = sm.model_code
WHERE sm.sku_code = 'BDL-UK-0035'
  AND mp.component_code = 'FOO-768-OAK-01462';
```

```sql
        SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty) AS units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON l.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND sku.is_bundle = false
    GROUP BY sm.model_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Model sales through bundle item SKUs
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        SUM(ol.qty * bi.qty * sm.qty) AS units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku bundle ON l.sku_id = bundle.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item ON bi.item_sku_id = item.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON item.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND bundle.is_bundle = true
    GROUP BY sm.model_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_units mu

GROUP BY cm.model_code
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs mapping directly to models
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON u.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND u.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs containing item SKUs that map to models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        u2.child_code AS model_code,
        u1.qty * u2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition u1
      ON u1.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u1.parent_code = b.sku_code
     AND u1.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND u1.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u1.valid_to IS NULL OR u1.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku item
      ON item.sku_code = u1.child_code
     AND item.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition u2
      ON u2.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u2.parent_code = item.sku_code
     AND u2.child_kind = 'model'
     AND u2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u2.valid_to IS NULL OR u2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up through component BOMs to find all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'GEA-146-GRY-00114'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id

      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-02-06')
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Expand bundle to item SKUs and their models with quantities
bundle_models AS (
    -- Get item SKUs in the bundle with their quantities
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_item_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-US-0239')
),
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Map item SKUs to their models
    SELECT 
        bm.item_sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bm.bundle_item_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_models bm
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bm.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Recursive expansion of model BOM to all components
model_components AS (
    -- Direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        stm.model_id,
        stm.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty,
        stm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_to_model stm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON stm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive expansion through component BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        mc.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        cb.qty AS component_qty,
        mc.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mc.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs mapping directly to models
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON u.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND u.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs containing item SKUs that map to models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        u2.child_code AS model_code,
        u1.qty * u2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition u1
      ON u1.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u1.parent_code = b.sku_code
     AND u1.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND u1.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u1.valid_to IS NULL OR u1.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku item
      ON item.sku_code = u1.child_code
     AND item.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition u2
      ON u2.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u2.parent_code = item.sku_code
     AND u2.child_kind = 'model'
     AND u2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u2.valid_to IS NULL OR u2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE component_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target component
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS root_component_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_multiplier
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-380-WAL-01243'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Walk up through component BOMs to find all parent assemblies
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        ct.root_component_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * ct.qty_multiplier
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN component_tree ct ON cb.child_component_id = ct.component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code
FROM company_model cm
JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
JOIN component_tree ct ON mb.component_id = ct.component_id
WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
ORDER BY cm.model_code;
```

```sql
    -- Start with the target component
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS child_component_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_child
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'ASM-612-03640'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Walk up: find parents that contain this component (directly or through sub-assemblies)
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS component_id,
        ch.child_component_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * ch.qty_per_child AS qty_per_child
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN component_hierarchy ch ON cb.child_component_id = ch.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code
FROM company_model cm
JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
JOIN component_hierarchy ch ON mb.component_id = ch.component_id
WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
ORDER BY cm.model_code;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKU -> model directly
    SELECT u.parent_code AS sku_code, u.child_code AS model_code, u.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku' AND u.child_kind = 'model'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    UNION ALL
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT b.parent_code AS sku_code, sm.model_code, b.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN sku_models sm ON sm.sku_code = b.child_code
    WHERE b.parent_kind = 'sku' AND b.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
model_units AS (
    SELECT sm.model_code, SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty) AS units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_models sm ON sm.sku_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
    GROUP BY sm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
ORDER BY units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bundle_contents AS (
    -- Direct SKUs that map to the target model
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'ER3-140OAK94-0094')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- SKUs inside bundles that map to the target model
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'ER3-140OAK94-0094')
),

    FROM bundle_contents
    GROUP BY sku_id

-- Find completed orders in 2024 with their line quantities
order_lines_2024 AS (

        ol.listing_id,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: direct SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: bundle items that are themselves bundles
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        be.model_id,
        CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) * be.model_qty_per_sku AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle_expansion be ON bi.bundle_sku_id = be.sku_id
),
-- Get all SKUs that map to the target model (directly or through bundles), with their effective model quantity
model_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        sku_id,
        model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_expansion
    WHERE model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'ER2-140GRY79-0370')
),
-- Also include direct mappings (not through bundles) that might not be in the recursive result
direct_model_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'ER2-140GRY79-0370')
),
all_model_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty_per_sku FROM model_skus
    UNION
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty_per_sku FROM direct_model_skus
),
-- Get completed orders in 2024
completed_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
)
-- Sum up all model units sold
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * ams.model_qty_per_sku), 0) AS total_model_units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN all_model_skus ams ON l.sku_id = ams.sku_id
JOIN completed_orders_2024 co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get all SKUs that map directly to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'CO6-140GRY29-0320')
),
-- Get all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to the target model
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS item_qty_in_bundle,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_item_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'CO6-140GRY29-0320')
),
-- Calculate total model units sold from direct SKUs
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * ds.model_qty_per_sku), 0) AS direct_model_units
    FROM direct_skus ds
    JOIN listing l ON ds.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
),
-- Calculate total model units sold from bundle SKUs
bundle_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * bs.item_qty_in_bundle * bs.model_qty_per_item_sku), 0) AS bundle_model_units
    FROM bundle_skus bs
    JOIN listing l ON bs.bundle_sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    d.direct_model_units + b.bundle_model_units AS total_model_units_sold
FROM direct_sales d
CROSS JOIN bundle_sales b;
```

```sql
        bundle_edge.qty * item_edge.qty * model_edge.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bundle_edge

        AND bundle_edge.parent_code = b.sku_code
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all SKUs that map directly to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634')
),
-- Get all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to the target model
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS item_qty_in_bundle,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_item_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634')
),
-- Get all listings for direct SKUs
direct_listings AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        ds.model_qty_per_sku
    FROM listing l
    JOIN direct_skus ds ON l.sku_id = ds.sku_id
),
-- Get all listings for bundle SKUs
bundle_listings AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,
        l.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        bs.item_sku_id,
        bs.item_qty_in_bundle,
        bs.model_qty_per_item_sku
    FROM listing l
    JOIN bundle_skus bs ON l.sku_id = bs.bundle_sku_id
),
-- Calculate total model units from direct sales
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * dl.model_qty_per_sku), 0) AS direct_model_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN direct_listings dl ON ol.listing_id = dl.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
-- Calculate total model units from bundle sales
bundle_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * bl.item_qty_in_bundle * bl.model_qty_per_item_sku), 0) AS bundle_model_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN bundle_listings bl ON ol.listing_id = bl.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    d.direct_model_units + b.bundle_model_units AS total_model_units_sold
FROM direct_sales d
CROSS JOIN bundle_sales b;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model_qty AS (
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings
    SELECT 
        u.parent_code AS sku_code,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.child_kind = 'model'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        b.parent_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        b.qty * sm.qty_per_sku AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN sku_model_qty sm ON b.child_kind = 'sku' AND b.child_code = sm.sku_code
    WHERE b.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty_per_sku), 0) AS total_units_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
JOIN sku_model_qty sm ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
  AND sm.model_code = 'NO7-180WAL49-0340';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model_paths AS (
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU to item SKU to model
    SELECT 
        bundle.parent_code AS sku_code,
        smp.model_code,
        bundle.qty * smp.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition bundle
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get all order lines for completed orders in 2024 for store Amazon-CA-14
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
),
-- Expand bundles to get underlying item SKUs with quantities
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id AS final_sku_id,
        CAST(ol.order_line_qty AS DOUBLE) AS final_sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id AS final_sku_id,
        CAST(ol.order_line_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS final_sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.final_sku_qty,
        es.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.final_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOM: find all paths from models down to parts
model_component_tree AS (
    -- Start with direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.final_sku_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(sm.final_sku_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(sm.model_qty_per_sku AS DOUBLE) * CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= sm.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse through component BOMs
    SELECT 
        mct.order_id,
        mct.line_no,
        mct.final_sku_qty,
        mct.order_date,
        mct.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        CAST(mct.total_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM model_component_tree mct
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mct.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= mct.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= mct.order_date)
)
-- Sum total quantity of the target part consumed
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mct.total_qty), 0) AS total_part_consumed
FROM model_component_tree mct
JOIN component c ON mct.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-228-WAL-00998'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id

    JOIN sku_model sm ON sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to their models
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku,
        TRUE AS is_bundle_item
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku bundle ON ol.sku_id = bundle.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE bundle.is_bundle = true
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode components from models
component_tree AS (
    -- Base: direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.line_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.model_qty_per_sku,
        mb.component_id,

        CAST(sm.line_qty AS DOUBLE) * sm.model_qty_per_sku * CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= sm.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT

        ct.line_no,
        ct.sku_id,
        ct.line_qty,
        ct.order_date,
        ct.model_id,

        ct.total_qty * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM component_tree ct
    JOIN component parent ON ct.component_id = parent.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON parent.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE parent.is_assembly = true
```

```sql
        ol.line_no,

    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
```

```sql
        es.line_no,
        es.original_sku_id,
        es.item_sku_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es

        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(sm.sku_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(sm.model_qty_per_sku AS DOUBLE) * CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM sku_models sm
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_models AS (

    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s

     AND uc.child_kind = 'model'

    SELECT
```

```sql
    JOIN u_composition uc 
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
     AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sku_to_models stm ON stm.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
```

```sql
    FROM expanded_skus es
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Amazon-JP-13 in 2023
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
-- Get all order lines with their SKU quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
),
-- Expand bundles: for each order line, get the underlying item SKUs with quantities
-- If SKU is bundle, explode to item SKUs; if not bundle, keep as-is
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty_per_line,
        1 AS item_qty_per_sku,  -- for non-bundle, 1 unit of the SKU itself
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty_per_line,
        bi.qty AS item_qty_per_sku,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Map SKUs to models with quantities
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.sku_id,
        es.sku_qty_per_line,
        es.item_qty_per_sku,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all component paths from models down to parts
-- We need to find quantity of part TAB-874-OAK-02567 in each model
part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up through component BOMs
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-874-OAK-02567'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Walk up: find parents of current components
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM part_tree pt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON pt.component_id = cb.child_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- For each model, find quantity of target part using BOM valid on order date
-- First get model-component relationships with historical validity
model_bom_historical AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS model_component_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Calculate part quantity per model (current BOM for the recursive structure)
model_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mbh.model_id,
        SUM(CAST(mbh.model_component_qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom_historical mbh
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mbh.component_id = pt.component_id
    GROUP BY mbh.model_id
),
-- Calculate total part consumption
total_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            sm.sku_qty_per_line * 
            sm.item_qty_per_sku * 
            sm.model_qty_per_sku * 
            COALESCE(mpq.part_qty_per_model, 0)
        ) AS total_part_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    LEFT JOIN model_part_qty mpq ON sm.model_id = mpq.model_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(total_part_qty, 0) AS total_part_qty
FROM total_consumption;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model_qty AS (

    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc

     AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false

    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,

    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
     AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sku_model_qty sm
      ON sm.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
order_model_units AS (

        sm.model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * sm.model_qty) AS total_units

    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs with quantities
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_id AS base_sku_id,
        1 AS sku_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        b.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        b.item_sku_id AS base_sku_id,
        b.qty AS sku_multiplier
    FROM bundle_item b
),
-- Get all model mappings for SKUs (through expanded bundles)
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        e.sku_id,
        e.sku_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM expanded_skus e
    JOIN sku_model sm ON e.base_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Calculate completed order lines with their model quantities
order_model_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        ol.qty * sm.sku_multiplier * sm.model_qty_per_sku AS total_model_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN sku_models sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM company_model cm
JOIN order_model_lines oml ON cm.model_id = oml.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(oml.total_model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Start from direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'NO7-160WAL61-0643')
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-27'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-27')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * bt.qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON bt.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-27'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-27')
      AND (SELECT is_assembly FROM component WHERE component_id = bt.component_id) = true
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(bt.qty_per_unit * c.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs with quantities
expanded_sku AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to themselves with qty 1
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_id AS base_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        b.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id AS base_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON b.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
-- Get completed orders in CA in 2023
ca_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
),
-- Order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        SUM(ol.qty) AS line_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN ca_orders_2023 co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    GROUP BY ol.listing_id, l.sku_id
),
-- Expand to base SKUs (handling bundles)
base_sku_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        es.base_sku_id,
        SUM(osq.line_qty * es.bundle_multiplier) AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN expanded_sku es ON osq.sku_id = es.sku_id
    GROUP BY es.base_sku_id
),
-- Map base SKUs to models
sku_model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        SUM(bss.total_qty * sm.qty) AS model_units
    FROM base_sku_sales bss
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bss.base_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    GROUP BY sm.model_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM sku_model_sales sms
JOIN company_model cm ON sms.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY sms.model_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bundle_to_sku AS (
    -- Direct item SKUs in the bundle
    SELECT 
        bundle_edge.child_code AS sku_code,
        bundle_edge.qty AS qty_per_bundle
    FROM u_composition bundle_edge
    WHERE bundle_edge.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND bundle_edge.parent_code = 'BDL-DE-0328'
      AND bundle_edge.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND bundle_edge.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (bundle_edge.valid_to IS NULL OR bundle_edge.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Item SKUs to their models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code,
        b.qty_per_bundle,
        item_edge.child_code AS model_code,
        item_edge.qty AS qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_to_sku b
    JOIN u_composition item_edge
        ON item_edge.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND item_edge.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND item_edge.child_kind = 'model'
        AND item_edge.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (item_edge.valid_to IS NULL OR item_edge.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
model_to_component AS (
    -- Direct components of models
    SELECT 
        sm.model_code,
        sm.qty_per_bundle,
        sm.qty_per_sku,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_model
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN u_composition c
        ON c.parent_kind = 'model'
        AND c.parent_code = sm.model_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'component'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components inside assembly components
    SELECT 
        mc.model_code,
        mc.qty_per_bundle,
        mc.qty_per_sku,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        mc.qty_per_model * c.qty AS qty_per_model
    FROM model_to_component mc
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mc.component_code
    JOIN u_composition c
        ON c.parent_kind = 'component'
        AND c.parent_code = mc.component_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'component'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(qty_per_bundle * qty_per_sku * qty_per_model), 0) AS total_units
FROM model_to_component
WHERE component_code = 'LEG-806-BLK-02750';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_to_component AS (
    -- Direct model to component mappings
    SELECT 
        m.model_code,
        uc.child_code AS component_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Model to assembly component, then recursively expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        m.model_code,
        uc.child_code AS component_code,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON u.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND u.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        bs.sku_id,
        bs.sku_code,
        u2.child_code AS model_code,
        u1.qty * u2.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku bs
    JOIN u_composition u1
      ON u1.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u1.parent_code = bs.sku_code
     AND u1.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku s
      ON s.sku_code = u1.child_code
    JOIN u_composition u2
      ON u2.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND u2.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND u2.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE bs.is_bundle = true
      AND u1.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u1.valid_to IS NULL OR u1.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      AND u2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u2.valid_to IS NULL OR u2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
```

```sql
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
```
```sql
        u.parent_code AS sku_code,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS model_qty
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'

    SELECT 
        b.parent_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        b.qty * sm.model_qty AS model_qty
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model_units AS (
    -- For non-bundle SKUs: direct mapping to models
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
      AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- For bundle SKUs: item SKUs inside bundle, then their model mappings
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        b.is_bundle,
        uc2.child_code AS model_code,
        uc1.qty * uc2.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc1 ON uc1.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc1.parent_code = b.sku_code
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_code = uc1.child_code
    JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc2.parent_code = item.sku_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
      AND uc1.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND uc2.child_kind = 'model'
      AND uc1.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc1.valid_to IS NULL OR uc1.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      AND uc2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR uc2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        smu.model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * smu.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sku_model_units smu ON smu.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'US'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY smu.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM order_model_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_units AS (
    -- Get all order lines with their SKU and quantity
    SELECT 
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        s2.country,
        o.order_date,
        o.status
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store s2 ON l.store_id = s2.store_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s2.country = 'UK'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs, map directly to models
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        u.parent_code AS sku_code,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.child_kind = 'model'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- For bundle SKUs, get item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        u.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        u.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        u.qty AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Map bundle item SKUs to models
bundle_item_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_code,
        bi.item_sku_code,
        bi.item_qty_per_bundle,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON bi.item_sku_code = sm.sku_code
),
-- Calculate total model units for each order line
model_order_units AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        mu.line_qty * sm.model_qty_per_sku AS total_model_units,

    FROM model_units mu
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,

        l.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,

        CAST(ol.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_sku_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-DE-01'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively traverse down the BOM using validity on order_date
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN uc.child_kind = 'sku' THEN ss_child.sku_id
            WHEN uc.child_kind = 'model' THEN NULL
            ELSE NULL
        END AS sku_id,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,
        CASE WHEN uc.child_kind = 'sku' THEN ss_child.is_bundle ELSE FALSE END AS is_bundle,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_sku_qty * uc.qty AS total_sku_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
      ON uc.parent_kind = CASE WHEN be.is_bundle THEN 'sku' ELSE 'sku' END
     AND uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
     AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= be.order_date)
    LEFT JOIN sales_sku ss_child ON ss_child.sku_code = uc.child_code AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE be.is_bundle OR (NOT be.is_bundle AND be.sku_id IS NOT NULL)
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs, map to models
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_sku_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
     AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
     AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= be.order_date)
    WHERE NOT be.is_bundle
      AND be.sku_code NOT IN (SELECT parent_code FROM u_composition WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'sku')
),

        model_code
    FROM sku_to_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items that are SKUs map to models
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_sku_qty * uc.qty AS total_model_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
     AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
     AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= be.order_date)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT

        uc.child_code AS component_code

    JOIN u_composition uc

     AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
     AND uc.valid_from <= mc.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= mc.order_date)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
```
```sql
        u.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition u ON u.parent_kind = 'sku' AND u.parent_code = s.sku_code AND u.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        bu.qty * sm.model_qty_per_sku AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bu ON bu.parent_kind = 'sku' AND bu.parent_code = b.sku_code AND bu.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = bu.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND bu.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (bu.valid_to IS NULL OR bu.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY sm.model_code
)

LIMIT 3;
```

```cypher
MATCH (so:SalesOrder {status: 'completed'})-[:PLACED_IN]->(s:Store {country: 'CA'})
WHERE date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2024
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH so, hl, l, sku, CASE WHEN sku.is_bundle THEN true ELSE false END AS is_bundle
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[b:BUNDLES]->(item:SKU)-[:MAPS_TO]->(m:Model)
WITH so, hl, l, sku, is_bundle, item, b, m
WHERE NOT is_bundle OR (is_bundle AND item IS NOT NULL)
WITH so, hl, l, sku, is_bundle, item, b, m,
     CASE 
       WHEN is_bundle THEN b.qty * hl.qty 
       ELSE hl.qty 
     END AS bundle_qty,
     CASE 
       WHEN is_bundle THEN m 
       ELSE null 
     END AS bundle_model
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[mt:MAPS_TO]->(direct_m:Model)
WITH so, hl, l, sku, is_bundle, item, b, m, bundle_qty, bundle_model, direct_m, mt,
     CASE 
       WHEN is_bundle THEN bundle_model 
       ELSE direct_m 
     END AS final_model,
     CASE 
       WHEN is_bundle THEN mt.qty * bundle_qty
       ELSE mt.qty * hl.qty
     END AS direct_qty,
     bundle_qty AS final_bundle_qty
WITH so, hl, l, sku, is_bundle, final_model, 
     CASE 
       WHEN is_bundle THEN final_bundle_qty 
       ELSE direct_qty 
     END AS model_qty
WHERE final_model IS NOT NULL
WITH final_model.model_code AS model_code, SUM(model_qty) AS total_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN model_code
```
